title: Museum audio guide
instructions: Bir şehir müzesinin sesli rehberi. Uzun bir metin; katları, yönleri ve yasakları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Welcome to the City History Museum. This guide takes about one hour.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: You are now in the main hall, on the ground floor. Here you can see old maps of the city.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The oldest map is from fifteen fifty. It shows the city when only two thousand people lived here.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Today, more than half a million people live in the city.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Now, please go up the stairs to the first floor. Turn left for the Roman rooms.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Here you can see coins, cups and jewellery. Please do not touch anything in these rooms.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: On the right side of the first floor is the modern history room, with photos from the last hundred years.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: You can take photos in the museum, but please do not use a flash.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The museum shop and café are on the ground floor, next to the main door.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The museum closes at five thirty, but the café closes at five.

options: in the main hall on the ground floor
